synth.notes:
Moves: A1-A4 move the selected piece/axis one 3x3 block (axis moves only on rows). A move is blocked by the board edge or by overlapping another piece. A5 cycles axis -> pieces, largest first -> axis. A7 undoes the last move and costs nothing.
Mirror: every piece block in row b reflects to row 2A-b. Frame = per-block layered composite (piece > reflection > target > wall). Centre pixel = first solid sprite, else the top sprite fill. Objects are then re-extracted as 4-connected components of own cells plus all 0 cells.
Missed mechanic (transition 97): the counter is not static. The first 64 actions per level are free; after that every non-A7 action shrinks it (h=min(64,128-n), y=64-h). Once it has shrunk, the spent bar counts as one extra player component ranked first, so piece names shift +1.
The action count n is hidden state, used only when the incoming state equals my last output. Otherwise the fallback is n=128-h if h<64, else 0. Stateless, the program scores 102/104 (fails 97 and t
